component.name: TeraConvert
component.summary: Local file conversion and validated compression for Nautilus
Chuyển đổi và tối ưu tệp tin có xác minh cho Nautilus

description.p: Convert files from GNOME Files using a native C11 extension, daemon and GTK interface. Some operations use external helpers and Python.
Chuyển đổi tệp từ GNOME Files bằng tiện ích C11, daemon và giao diện GTK. Một số tác vụ dùng chương trình phụ trợ và Python.

ul.li: Preserve supported PNG/JPEG image content, static PDF content, OOXML/ODF entry bytes and supported integer audio samples.
Remove trailing MP4/MOV padding or validate supported stream-copy remuxing. Unverified features are skipped.
Separate lossy video and PDF presets, with no fixed size or quality guarantee.
Batch results, per-batch cancellation and a JSON command-line client.
Optional local AI background removal requires a compatible model with a SHA-256 receipt and ONNX Runtime.

description.p: Add a native Quick Look viewer with local image, text, PDF and media previews, asynchronous loading, keyboard navigation and optional Nautilus Space integration.
Add validated preservation modes, versioned batch IPC, owned temporary workspaces and research tools.
